    def solve(n, edges):
        graph = defaultdict(list)
        degree = [0] * (n + 1)
        
        for u, v in edges:
            graph[u].append(v)
            graph[v].append(u)
            degree[u] += 1
            degree[v] += 1
        
        leaves = set()
        buds = set()
        stack = []
        
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            if degree[i] == 1:
                leaves.add(i)
                stack.append(i)
            elif degree[i] == 2:
                buds.add(i)
        
        while stack:
            leaf = stack.pop()
            for neighbor in graph[leaf]:
                degree[neighbor] -= 1
                if degree[neighbor] == 1:
                    leaves.add(neighbor)
                    stack.append(neighbor)
                elif degree[neighbor] == 2:
                    buds.add(neighbor)
        
        return max(1, len(leaves) - len(buds))
